The roster and position-group comparison below explains where EdgeDesk’s separation comes from on the side it can measure; Texas Southern is absent from the FBS player dataset, so the exact size of that gap is not established.
Data confidence on this matchup is 59% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
